title: M4 staged DuckDB-to-Parquet plus clean manifest generation
instructions: Use the accepted M2 pilot-plan artifact and accepted M3 rollback artifact to execute the first staged target write for daily_basic month=2026-05 only. Open the source DuckDB at C:/Workspace/Quanttrading/Quanttrading/data/quant.duckdb with OPEN_READONLY only. Before writing, realpath/prefix-check staging path and clean manifest path: both must resolve under C:/Workspace/Cowork and must not be under C:/Workspace/Quanttrading/Quanttrading. Export only rows where trade_date >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND trade_date < DATE '2026-06-01'. Prefer DuckDB COPY (SELECT ...) TO project-local Parquet if valid with OPEN_READONLY; otherwise use an equivalent read-only source query plus target Parquet writer, or mark blocked. Generate clean-version-manifest/v1 with schema_version exactly "clean-version-manifest/v1" and initial status "quality-pending". Manifest must record source baseline artifact, contract alignment artifact, pilot plan artifact, rollback artifact, source SQL, row count, date range, schema hash/checksum, provenance columns/distribution, and target files. Do not write data/clean/daily_basic/_current.json. Do not create or modify metadata/query-entry/daily_basic.json. Do not modify metadata/dataset-contracts. Write staging artifacts, then finish the task for Claude review.
summary: M4 staged clean generation completed for daily_basic month=2026-05. Opened source C:/Workspace/Quanttrading/Quanttrading/data/quant.duckdb with node-duckdb OPEN_READONLY, exported only trade_date >= 2026-05-01 and < 2026-06-01 to project-local staging Parquet, and generated clean-version-manifest/v1 with status quality-pending. Output row_count=75018, duplicate_key_count=0, source/target ordered row checksum match, structural schema hash match, boundary checks passed. No source write/DDL, no source COPY target, no _current.json write, no query-entry pointer write, no metadata contract write, and no M5+ task files created. First attempt stopped before manifest on overly strict full DESCRIBE constraint hash; partial staging/clean dirs were cleaned within M3 rollback scope and rerun succeeded.
